title: Series from a transition
statement:
Which transition emits in the Paschen series?

[_]{a}

explanations: Ends at n=3 from a higher initial state.

hints: Paschen lines terminate at the third level.
Compare both initial and final n.
solution: Emission goes down. Paschen lines terminate at the third level. Compare both initial and final n. Ends at n=3 from a higher initial state.
